reply_text:
*Two findings to address before merge:*

1. *Incorrect extension parsing* — `src/extension.js:2`
   `split('.')[1]` takes the second segment, not the last, and doesn’t lowercase it. Verified: `report.v2.pdf` and `photo.JPG` return `application/octet-stream`, while `photo.jpg.exe` incorrectly returns `image/jpeg`. Names without dots also return `undefined` instead of the documented empty string.
   *Fix:* Extract the text after the last dot, lowercase it, and return `''` when no extension exists.

2. *Unknown extensions can return inherited objects/functions* — `src/content-type.js:11`
   `TYPES` inherits from `Object.prototype`, so `file.constructor` returns the `Object` function and `file.__proto__` returns an object instead of the fallback MIME string.
   *Fix:* Use an own-property lookup, a null-prototype dictionary, or a `Map`.

All 3 existing tests pass, but they don’t cover these cases; I reproduced both separately. No files changed.
